name: Golemagg the Incinerator
source: [core: vmangos] Melee 2,202 to 2,919 a 2.0 s swing before armor: vmangos core (github.com/vmangos/core, db_latest db-4641790): creature_template, spell_template, the boss script, damage_multiplier 20.05. a 2006 Molten Core full clear from Blizzard's servers in WWS format (web.mit.edu/cat/project/WoW/MCDump200609/), hits after armor: 75 hits, 979 average after armor. Double Attack 18943: 50% of his landed hits give an extra swing (the Classic Era client's spell data), so one every 2 / (0.65 x 0.5) = 6.2 s on average with about 65% of swings landing (sim: a melee ability at the swing's range). Magma Splash 13880: a Fire DoT stacking to 50 on the tank, 50 every 3 s a stack (the log's ticks 216 average).
notes: The Core Ragers are another tank's job and left out. Magma Splash is modelled as a steady 4 stacks (200 Fire every 3 s), the log's tick average, without its 93 to 107 Fire hit on each application or its armor cut (about 250 a stack, so about 1,000 at 4 stacks, client data), which the sim can't model on an event yet. Double Attack's extra swings can't crush in the sim. Earthquake below 10% health and Pyroblast on random players are left out.

healing.notes: A 40-player Molten Core raid's main tank: 4 healers at 400 HPS each on it in 2 s heals (800 a heal), a mix of paladins on Flash of Light rank 6 (about 600 at 400 healing power) and priests on Greater Heal rank 4 or downranked Heal. 1,600 HPS before overheal, 2.4 times an assumed 650 DTPS, the Classic Era Molten Core logs' ratio (wowsims/forever). Not from logs yet: replace with tools/warcraftlogs tank numbers.
